output.reason: Only 7.4.0 users can get the flag, so the 2.8x gap is confounded with the build. The brief deals with that properly: it compares flagged users with the random holdout inside 7.4.0, shows the 7.4.0 gap was already there on 2 Sep before the flag ramp, and checks the crash-reporting artifact (the SDK upgrade now captures native crashes) against the store console, which counts crashes independently. It names Pixelda as the top crash cluster in 7.4.0 and gives clear next steps, though it would claim more than the two allowed catalogue items could back up.
